name: ASVP Side Events 2023
information:
La competizione è organizzata con il patrocinio del Comune di Varese.

![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png)

**Note: you will have to pay 10€ extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member.**
Membership is free! More info in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ASVPSideEvents2023#29641-registration-registrazione-faq).
